breakdown.description: Boundary section contains incompatible boundary condition types (e.g., periodic vs Dirichlet/Neumann).
breakdown.reason: The original prompt contained contradictory boundary conditions: Dirichlet on all four edges and also periodic. The ground truth resolved this by removing the incorrect periodic condition. The generated specification correctly omits any mention of periodic boundary conditions and only specifies the Dirichlet conditions, thus fixing the inconsistency.
